description: Tabbed activity panel that combines TmActivityTimeline, TmActivityComments, and TmActivityAttachments into a single component with switchable tabs. Each tab can be shown or hidden independently. Tab badges display item counts.

parameters.name: OnCommentAdded
parameters.description: Raised with the submitted HTML when the user posts a new comment. Stays for hosts that only need the body; prefer OnCommentSubmitted when the internal flag matters. Forwarded to TmActivityComments.

parameters.name: OnCommentSubmitted
parameters.description: Raised before OnCommentAdded with the HTML and the composer internal flag. Forwarded unchanged; the log does not interpret or filter internal comments.

parameters.name: OnCommentDeleted
parameters.description: Raised with the comment id when the user deletes a comment. Forwarded to TmActivityComments.

parameters.name: CommentActions
parameters.description: Consumer actions rendered after the built-in Edit and Delete buttons, once per comment. Forwarded; the log does not interpret the fragment.

parameters.name: SupportsMentions
parameters.description: Passes mention autocomplete through to the comments tab. Without MentionProvider the editor stays off even when this is true. Defaults to false.

parameters.name: MentionProvider
parameters.description: People source for the comments-tab mention picker. Null (or SupportsMentions false) leaves autocomplete off.

parameters.name: ShowInternalToggle
parameters.description: Shows the internal switch in the new-comment composer. Off by default. The log never hides the resulting comment — the consumer filters visibility.

parameters.name: TimelineFilter
parameters.description: Optional free-text filter forwarded to the timeline tab (author, content, entry type).

parameters.name: TimelineEntryTypeFilter
parameters.description: Optional entry-type filter forwarded to the timeline tab; null/empty shows all types.

parameters.name: TimelineEntryTypeFilterOptions
parameters.description: Optional explicit entry-type options for the timeline filter bar.

parameters.name: TimelinePageSize
parameters.description: Page size for the timeline tab's incremental "load more" paging. null (default) shows every entry.

parameters.name: ShowTimelineFilterBar
parameters.description: When true, the timeline tab renders a built-in search + type filter bar (default: false).

parameters.name: TimelineDataProvider
parameters.description: Optional async data provider for the timeline tab (server-side filtering + pagination).

examples.title: Full activity log with all tabs
examples.code:
<TmActivityLog EntityId="@entityId"
               TimelineEntries="@timelineEntries"
               Comments="@comments"
               Attachments="@attachments"
               AttachmentProvider="@attachmentProvider"
               FileProvider="@fileProvider"
               OnCommentAdded="HandleCommentAdded"
               OnCommentDeleted="HandleCommentDeleted" />
